ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Schtasks Execution AppData Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a schtask that executes a file from C:\Users\<USER>\AppData\Local

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/RU.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TR.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*NT\\ AUT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SYSTEM\\ .*"))) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX(".*TeamViewer\\_\\\.exe.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ TVInstallRestore.*")))
